instructions: You are a warm American English woman in her mid-thirties telling a friend's story. Calm, relatable, slightly conversational, emotionally responsive. Not a commercial, not a salesperson, not a movie trailer, not a TikTok AI voice. Speak as if sitting across from someone with cocoa, gently explaining Lauren's Christmas overwhelm and then the relief when she finds a simpler way. Natural pacing, small breaths between thoughts. Soften on the stress, lift slightly on the discovery, and end warm and resolved. Do not over-act.
script: This is Lauren. She loves Christmas… but every year, she has the same problem. Gifts. Dinner. Decorations. School events. Family plans… and somehow, she’s supposed to remember all of it. And the closer Christmas gets, the longer the list becomes… and the more expensive everything feels. She’s planning Christmas for everyone else… but she’s running out of time to actually enjoy it herself. Then Lauren finds a simpler way to keep Christmas together. Now the gifts, budget, meals and plans finally have a place… so Lauren can enjoy Christmas too. Plan less. Enjoy Christmas more.
